ルーシー&レベッカ&ルシラー.why: game-i merged three Cyberpunk collab characters into one banner; primary_name() only ever resolves the first token, so the other two have to be named here. Splash art is a full city scene, so the frontal cascade finds no face and the fallback crops background -- hence the box.

リンネー復刻&ザンニー復刻&フィービー復刻.why: Full-scene splash with the character small and in three-quarter view; cascade detects nothing.

リンネー&カルテジア&シャコンヌ.why: Same splash as her rerun banner; cascade detects nothing on it.
